title: Dualizing tensor comparison through a Cartesian square and etale factors
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum [def-pur-conventions]: $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $n\geq1$. All schemes are finite-type $k$-schemes; absolute separatedness is not assumed. All morphisms below are separated and of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Every smooth morphism below is assumed to have a pure relative dimension $d_h\geq0$. Work in the bounded constructible finite-Tor categories [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and constructible exceptional inverse images [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Write $\omega_h=Rh^!\Lambda$, take $c_{v,u}:R(vu)^!\simeq Ru^!Rv^!$ to be the specified adjunction conjugate of compact-support composition [def-pur-finite-exceptional-composition], and take $\theta_{h,M}$ and $\beta_{h,v}$ to be the specified counit transposes [def-pur-co-smoothness]. For composable smooth maps [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] put $\sigma_{u,v}=c_{v,u,\Lambda}^{-1}\theta_{u,\omega_v}\mathrm{sym}$. All pullback compositions, tensor constraints and unit comparisons below are the canonical derived ones [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].
For an etale map $e$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], use the counit-normalized comparison $\rho_e:Re^!\simeq Le^*$, its unit value $\eta_e:\omega_e\simeq\Lambda$, and $E_{e,h}=\rho_{e,\omega_h}c_{h,e,\Lambda}:\omega_{he}\simeq Le^*\omega_h$ [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization].
Let $q:A\to T$ and $p:T\to B$ be smooth, $G:Q\to T$ etale, $R=Q\times_TA$, and $q_Q:R\to Q$, $J:R\to A$ the Cartesian projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $H:W\to R$ be etale and put $a=q_QH$, $b=pG$, $F=JH$. Then
$$E_{J,q}\sigma_{q_Q,G}=\beta_{q,G}^{-1},$$
where the source of the left side is identified with $\omega_{q_Q}$ using $\eta_G$. There is also the identity
$$E_{J,pq}\sigma_{q_Q,b}=LJ^*\sigma_{q,p}\bigl(\beta_{q,G}^{-1}\otimes Lq_Q^*E_{G,p}\bigr),$$
from $\omega_{q_Q}\otimes Lq_Q^*\omega_b$ to $LJ^*\omega_{pq}$. Finally
$$E_{F,pq}\sigma_{a,b}=LF^*\sigma_{q,p}\bigl(((LH^*\beta_{q,G}^{-1})E_{H,q_Q})\otimes La^*E_{G,p}\bigr),$$
from $\omega_a\otimes La^*\omega_b$ to $LF^*\omega_{pq}$. Here $E_{F,pq}=LH^*E_{J,pq}\circ E_{H,pqJ}$ under the canonical composition identifications. All equalities use the normalized $E$, the actual Cartesian $\beta$, and the specified $\sigma$; no Cartesian condition on the square with horizontal maps $F,G$ is imposed.

proof.text: By etale base-change stability $J$ is etale, and by etale composition $F=JH$ is etale. Every etale map here ($G$, $H$, $J$, $F$) is smooth of relative dimension $0$, so it is a legitimate member of the smooth pairs and triples below. Smooth relative-dimension permanence then gives $q_Q$ smooth of dimension $d_q$, $a=q_QH$ of dimension $d_q$, $b=pG$ of dimension $d_p$, and all the smooth composites used below ($qJ=Gq_Q$ of dimension $d_q$, $pqJ$ of dimension $d_p+d_q$). Thus the normalization and smooth-triple identities apply without absolute separatedness. The equalities $Gq_Q=qJ$ and $ba=pqF$ follow from the defining fibre product.

source.place: Step 1, etale localization and the pentagon for the twofold diagonal: compare towers through one Cartesian square and two etale factors (old item step 10); agent-written refinement of the blueprint argument

proof.text: Apply clause (3) of the etale normalization with $(h,h',e,e')=(q,q_Q,G,J)$. It gives $\beta_{q,G}=\sigma_{q_Q,G}^{-1}E_{J,q}^{-1}$, with the stipulated $\eta_G$ unit identification. Inverting this equality proves $E_{J,q}\sigma_{q_Q,G}=\beta_{q,G}^{-1}$, including invertibility of the maps being cancelled.

proof.text: Apply lem-pur-etale-middle-tensor-assembly with x equal to the actual inverse beta from Step 2. It gives SecondEquation from FirstEquation; smooth pure relative dimension of qQ follows by base change. This is the algebraic assembly in original Steps 3--4.

Apply lem-pur-etale-composite-e-composition with q replaced by q followed by p, and etale arrows J,H. This supplies the exact CompositeEEquation, including its associativity congruence and inverse canonical pullback compositor.

Apply lem-pur-etale-tensor-source-transport to H, with SecondEquation and the canonical CompositeEEquation from the preceding step. Its displayed pullback compositors are squarePull and outerPull, and its first input is finalFirstCompared, so it gives ThirdEquation. Conjoin the four established identities.

tool_uses.why: Generic geometric permanence checks the domains of the smooth triple identities, not an alternative proof of purity.
Associativity of the fixed compact-support compositor identifies the normalized composite E; the unit does not reconstruct compact-support functors.
Generic canonical derived pullback compositor identifies LH*Lq_Q* with La* and LH*LJ* with LF*.
Generic monoidality of derived pullback distributes LH* over the displayed tensor input map.
Generic fact that an etale map is smooth of relative dimension zero, so G, H, J, F enter the smooth-triple and normalization identities; no node of the unit states it.
